summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K carrying its interim report for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings disclosure rather than a special situation. Revenue rose 22% to $3,238 million on higher DARZALEX and Kesimpta royalties ($2,699 million, +22%) and EPKINLY net sales ($491 million, +47%); operating profit was $986 million versus $1,007 million. The release cites prior Merus integration charges of $87 million, confirming an already-completed acquisition, plus European and Japanese epcoritamab approvals and new petosemtamab Phase 3 trials. No transaction terms, board recommendation or advisors are stated; watch pivotal readouts across epcoritamab, Rina-S and petosemtamab.
